mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contract_id = #{contractId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM oa_contract_fulfilment_term term WHERE term.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND term.contract_id = #{contractId} AND term.deleted = 0 ORDER BY term.sort_no, term.term_no, term.term_id

SELECT FROM oa_contract_milestone milestone JOIN oa_contract contract ON contract.tenant_id = milestone.tenant_id AND contract.contract_id = milestone.contract_id WHERE contract.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contract.contract_id = #{contractId} AND contract.deleted = 0 AND milestone.deleted = 0 ORDER BY milestone.milestone_no, milestone.id
SELECT FROM oa_contract_payment_schedule schedule WHERE schedule.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND schedule.contract_id = #{contractId} AND schedule.deleted = 0 ORDER BY schedule.payment_no, schedule.id
